changelog: - **Run bar: Run settings stays put.** The step count now keeps room for its longest text, so Run settings and the steady-state note no longer move right as the step count grows or when the run ends; before, they moved by up to about 80 px. Where the run bar is tight (about 900 px wide), the steady-state note now reads "Steady" (Korean "흐름 계속") instead of being cut off; its tooltip and the screen reader keep the whole text.
